## Activity

During December 2018, West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 392 captures. This total represents the reported activity for the month and provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures below.

## Image quality

Of the 392 captures recorded in December 2018, 12 were marked ungradable. The ungradable rate was 3.1 per cent. This measure identifies the proportion of captures that could not be used for grading and is reported alongside the total capture volume.

## Grading

The grading outcome for the month included 56 referable results. The median lag was 8. Together, the referable count and median lag describe the grading activity associated with the 392 captures completed at West Gate Eye Clinic during December 2018.
